messages.body_plain:
謝謝幫忙!

李克耘於 2017年1月12日星期四 UTC+8下午4時49分20秒寫道：

>
>
> 鄭美龍於 2017年1月5日星期四 UTC+8下午11時26分17秒寫道：
> >
> > #建立NBA球員的進球、罰球向量資料(3人)
> >
> > #奇元素為進球數，偶元素為罰球數
> >
> > NBA2016.Lin    <- c(6,3,5,0,4,0,4,2,6,4) #6,5,4,4,5
> >
> > NBA2016.Booker <- c(6,4,6,1,3,0,1,1,2,0) #6,6,3,1,2
> >
> > NBA2016.Lopez  <- c(6,1,3,4,12,4,8,7,4,0)#6,3,12,8,4
> >
> > # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
> >
> > #計算3位NBA球員的總得分與平均得分
> >
> > #假設每位球員每場比賽都會投進1顆3分球，但若該場次進球數為0，則該場無3分球進球數為0
> >
> > # --- Lin
> >
> > Count.3Point.Lin <- sum(!(NBA2016.Lin[c(1,3,5,7,9)]== 0))
> >
> > Total.Score.Lin <- sum(NBA2016.Lin*c(2,1))+Count.3Point.Lin
> >
> > Average.Score.Lin <- Total.Score.Lin/5
> >
> > # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
> >
> > # --- Booker
> >
> > Count.3Point.Booker <- sum(!(NBA2016.Booker[c(1,3,5,7,9)]== 0))
> >
> > Total.Score.Booker <- sum(NBA2016.Booker*c(2,1))+Count.3Point.Booker
> >
> > Average.Score.Booker <- Total.Score.Booker/5
> >
> > # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
> >
> > # --- Lopez
> >
> > Count.3Point.Lopez <- sum(!(NBA2016.Lopez[c(1,3,5,7,9)]== 0))
> >
> > Total.Score.Lopez <- sum(NBA2016.Lopez*c(2,1))+Count.3Point.Lopez
> >
> > Average.Score.Lopez <- Total.Score.Lopez/5
> >
> > # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
> >
> > # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
> >
> > #計算3位NBA球員的進球總數與得分總數
> >
> > # --- 3位NBA球員進球總數
> >
> > Total5.Count.Nets <- sum(NBA2016.Lin+NBA2016.Booker+NBA2016.Lopez+NBA2016.Bog+NBA2016.Kil)
> >
> > # --- 5位NBA球員得分總數
> >
> > Total5.Score.Nets <- Total.Score.Lin+Total.Score.Booker+
> >
> >                                  Total.Score.Lopez+Total.Score.Bog+Total.Score.Kil
> >
> > # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
> >
> > # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
> >
> > #列出每場比賽得分最多的球員
> >
> > # --- Lin
> >
> > NBA2016.Lin    <- c(6,3,5,0,4,0,4,2,6,4) #6,5,4,4,6
> >
> > Score.Lin <- numeric(5) # Score.Lin = [0, 0, 0, 0, 0]
> >
> > for(i in 1:5)
> >
> > {
> >
> >   Count.3Point.Lin.i  <- sum(!(NBA2016.Lin[c(2*i-1)]== 0)) #判斷各場次進球數是否為0
> >
> >   Score.Lin.i <- sum(NBA2016.Lin[c(2*i-1,2*i)]*c(2,1))+Count.3Point.Lin.i #計算各場次總得分
> >
> >   Score.Lin[i]<- Score.Lin.i #將各場次總得分填入向量內(Score.Lin)
> >
> > }
> >
> > # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
> >
> > # --- Booker
> >
> > NBA2016.Booker <- c(6,4,6,1,3,0,1,1,2,0) #6,6,3,1,2
> >
> > Score.Booker <- numeric(5) # Score.Booker = [0, 0, 0, 0, 0]
> >
> > for(i in 1:5)
> >
> > {
> >
> >   Count.3Point.Booker.i  <- sum(!(NBA2016.Booker[c(2*i-1)]== 0)) #判斷各場次進球數是否為0
> >
> >   Score.Booker.i <- sum(NBA2016.Booker[c(2*i-1,2*i)]*c(2,1))+Count.3Point.Booker.i #計算各場次總得分
> >
> >   Score.Booker[i]<- Score.Booker.i #將各場次總得分填入向量內(Score.Booker)
> >
> > }
> >
> > # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
> >
> > # --- Lopez
> >
> > NBA2016.Lopez  <- c(6,1,3,4,12,4,8,7,4,0)#6,3,12,8,4
> >
> > Score.Lopez <- numeric(5) # Score.Lopez = [0, 0, 0, 0, 0]
> >
> > for(i in 1:5)
> >
> > {
> >
> >   Count.3Point.Lopez.i  <- sum(!(NBA2016.Lopez[c(2*i-1)]== 0)) #判斷各場次進球數是否為0
> >
> >   Score.Lopez.i <- sum(NBA2016.Lopez[c(2*i-1,2*i)]*c(2,1))+Count.3Point.Lopez.i #計算各場次總得分
> >
> >   Score.Lopez[i]<- Score.Lopez.i #將各場次總得分填入向量內(Score.Lopez)
> >
> > }
> >
> > # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
> >
> >
> >
> > #用function rbind()建立矩陣
> >
> > Score.Starting.Nets <- rbind(Score.Lin,Score.Booker,Score.Lopez)
> >
> > colnames(Score.Starting.Nets) <- c("Game1","Game2","Game3","Game4","Game5")
> >
> > rownames(Score.Starting.Nets) <- c("Lin","Booker","Lopez")
> >
> > #找出每場比賽得分最高之球員
> >
> > Game1.max <- which.max(Score.Starting.Nets[,1])
> >
> > Game2.max <- which.max(Score.Starting.Nets[,2])
> >
> > Game3.max <- which.max(Score.Starting.Nets[,3])
> >
> > Game4.max <- which.max(Game.Score.Starting[,4])
> >
> > Game5.max <- which.max(Game.Score.Starting[,5])
> >
> > #列出每場比賽得分最高之球員
> >
> > print("The max score player in Game 1 is",Game.max_1)
> >
> > Game1.max
> >
> > print("The max score player in Game 2 is")
> >
> > Game2.max
> >
> > print("The max score player in Game 3 is")
> >
> > Game3.max
> >
> > print("The max score player in Game 4 is")
> >
> > Game4.max
> >
> > print("The max score player in Game 5 is")
> >
> > Game5.max
> >
> >
> > #以上為程式碼，執行結果如下
> >
> > > print("The max score player in Game 1 is",Game.max_1)
> >
> > [1] "The max score player in Game 1 is"
> >
> > > Game1.max
> >
> > Booker
> >
> >      2
> >
> > > print("The max score player in Game 2 is")
> >
> > [1] "The max score player in Game 2 is"
> >
> > > Game2.max
> >
> > Booker
> >
> >      2
> >
> > > print("The max score player in Game 3 is")
> >
> > [1] "The max score player in Game 3 is"
> >
> > > Game3.max
> >
> > Lopez
> >
> >     3
> >
> > > print("The max score player in Game 4 is")
> >
> > [1] "The max score player in Game 4 is"
> >
> > > Game4.max
> >
> > Lopez
> >
> >     3
> >
> > > print("The max score player in Game 5 is")
> >
> > [1] "The max score player in Game 5 is"
> >
> > > Game5.max
> >
> > Lin
> >
> >   1
> >
> >
> > #希望的執行結果如下
> >
> > "The max score player in Game 1 is"    : Booker
> >
> > "The max score player in Game 2 is"    : Booker
> >
> > "The max score player in Game 3 is"    : Lopez
> >
> > "The max score player in Game 4 is"    : Lopez
> >
> > "The max score player in Game 5 is"    : Lin
>
> 前面整理資料忽略，如果最後只是要把兩行變成一行，遇到的問題是字串合併
> 可以使用paste(), 另外你的變數太多了, 我這裡用sapply一次算五場比賽的得分王,並存成向量.
> Score.Starting.Nets<-data.frame(Score.Starting.Nets)
> Game.max<-sapply(Score.Starting.Nets,which.max)
> paste("The max score player in Game ",1," is    : ", row.names(Score.Starting.Nets)[Game.max[1]], sep="")
> paste("The max score player in Game ",2," is    : ", row.names(Score.Starting.Nets)[Game.max[2]], sep="")
> paste("The max score player in Game ",3," is    : ", row.names(Score.Starting.Nets)[Game.max[3]], sep="")
> paste("The max score player in Game ",4," is    : ", row.names(Score.Starting.Nets)[Game.max[4]], sep="")
> paste("The max score player in Game ",5," is    : ", row.names(Score.Starting.Nets)[Game.max[5]], sep="")
>
> 你參考看看.
>

messages.subject: factor只能用在vector? 能適用於matrix與 array嗎?
messages.subject_clean: factor只能用在vector? 能適用於matrix與 array嗎?
messages.body_plain:
grade <- c(82,56,72,88,65,85,81,68,85,96, 72,85,72,68,95,81,71,68,55,91)#每班10位同學, 2門學科(Math first then R)
Math_R.Matrix <- matrix(grade,c(10,2)) #每班10位同學, 2門學科, 1個班級，by column (Math first then R)；matrix
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------

# Names of column and row for the object "Math_R.3Array.2Class"
colnames(Math_R.Matrix) <- c("Math","R")
rownames(Math_R.Matrix) <- c("ID1","ID2","ID3","ID4","ID5","ID6","ID7","ID8","ID9","ID10")
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Matrix --> factor(ordered=TRUE)；
# A>90, 80<=B<90, 70<=C<80, 60<=D<70, F<60； A>B>C>D>F
Math_R.factor <- factor(Math_R.Matrix, levels=c("F","D","C","B","A"), ordered=TRUE)
Math_R.factor

#執行結果如下
 [1] <NA> <NA> <NA> <NA> <NA> <NA> <NA> <NA> <NA> <NA> <NA> <NA> <NA> <NA> <NA> <NA> <NA> <NA> <NA> <NA>
Levels: F < D < C < B < A

messages.subject: Re: factor只能用在vector? 能適用於matrix與 array嗎?
messages.subject_clean: factor只能用在vector? 能適用於matrix與 array嗎?
messages.body_plain:
Hi Tearice,

vector, matrix, array 資料型態須一致, 本例可使用 data.frame 即每行資料型態可不相同, cut 可將數值轉換為 factor, apply 可以取出每列資料, 進行 cut 轉換.

 <https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/-DGVp1BB5rOI/WKhhn6oEjzI/AAAAAAAALLk/MmiYQbOMW5kOYU-3xxjXk4tclB4IafC2wCLcB/s1600/%25E8%25B3%2587%25E6%2596%2599%25E8%25BD%2589%25E6%258F%259B%25E7%2582%25BA%25E5%258D%2580%25E9%2596%2593.png>

# title: 資料轉換為區間
# date: 2017.2.18

# vector, matrix, array 資料型態須一致
# data.frame 每一行資料型態可以不相同
# cut 可將數值轉換為factor

grade <- c(82,56,72,88,65,85,81,68,85,96, 72,85,72,68,95,81,71,68,55,91)
grade.df<- data.frame(matrix(grade, ncol=2))
colnames(grade.df) <- c("Math","R")
rownames(grade.df) <- c("ID1","ID2","ID3","ID4","ID5","ID6","ID7","ID8","ID9","ID10")

score <- as.data.frame(apply(grade.df, 2, function(x) cut(x,
                                                          breaks = c(-Inf, 60, 70, 80, 90, Inf),
                                                          labels = c("F", rev(LETTERS[1:4])),
                                                          right = TRUE)))

grade.df.final <- cbind(grade.df, score)
grade.df.final
str(grade.df.final)
# end

messages.body_plain:
想判斷聲音不知道 R 有相關套件嘛?

具體一點有兩個 idea:
1. 用手機收音, 資料傳給 R, 然後判斷看看是否有狗經過家門口, 再開啟錄影.
2. 用手機收音, 聽到桌球碰觸桌子時,計算碰觸幾次.碰觸球拍幾次, 聽到時報出次數.

或者是若用 machine learning 該從何處起頭呢?
